purpose: Use complementary target, nuisance and observation-support views to localise development failures without forcing legitimate superposition or information absence into binary target/noise labels.

runtime_axes.T_direct: direct evidence for the focal insect/actor
runtime_axes.C_coupled: target-linked local response attributed to the focal interaction
runtime_axes.N: exogenous nuisance risk capable of mimic/mask/attribution/support effects
runtime_axes.O: primary-stream observation support independent of T and N

pattern_rules.example: high target evidence + high nuisance + observable support
pattern_rules.interpretation: not automatically a contradiction; target and nuisance may both be true
pattern_rules.next_test: join independent biological/nuisance truth and test whether either representation is wrong or the state is legitimate superposition

pattern_rules.example: low target + low nuisance + unobservable support
pattern_rules.interpretation: information absence/shared blind spot; never biological absence
pattern_rules.next_test: audit support component failure and retain censored

pattern_rules.interpretation: retain candidate pixels but do not treat the window as claim-bearing positive/negative evidence
pattern_rules.next_test: independent reference truth and primary-stream support audit

pattern_rules.example: low target + high nuisance + non-failed support
pattern_rules.interpretation: possible target suppression or nuisance-driven ambiguity
pattern_rules.next_test: hold support/target or support/nuisance fixed and test the suspected representation

pattern_rules.example: weak direct insect evidence + high target-coupled response
pattern_rules.interpretation: possible indirect target evidence, not automatically a visit
pattern_rules.next_test: independent coupling truth must establish that the local target response was caused by insect contact

alternating_development.rule: When a representation/model defect is assigned to one subsystem, all sibling subsystems remain frozen for that diagnostic round.
forbidden: modify target and nuisance simultaneously after one contradiction
modify target and support simultaneously after one contradiction
modify nuisance and support simultaneously after one contradiction
use held-out truth while emitting observer outputs
relabel information absence as a model error solely to reduce undetermined rate
tune away legitimate target+nuisance or target-coupled superposition

stop_rule.reason: legitimate coupling, information absence and essential ambiguity may remain after a well-specified system is mature

forbidden: field visit accuracy before V15 held-out truth
claim that disagreement itself is error
claim that one observer wins because another is silent
claim that unobservable means no visit
